title: Welp- my biggest fear finally came true tonight at @jobtheplay #Broad...
transcript: This is just a quick PSA to anyone seeing job on Broadway. When they say that they have a no late seating policy, they mean it. I always leave at least a half hour early to get to the theater. But sometimes the MTA has other plans, as it did tonight. So I got here at 8:08 for an 8:00 curtain, and they wouldn't let me in. I'm obviously not mad at the show, just mad at the situation in general. I've lived here for five years now and never missed a show, so this is a first for me. So, yeah, that's your quick PSA for the day.
